svg.title: Ppopy service architecture
svg.desc: The Ppopy iPhone app communicates over HTTPS with API Gateway, then AWS Lambda and Aurora PostgreSQL via the RDS Data API. Lambda includes the catalog, knowledge base, and adaptive question selection. It verifies identities with external providers and optionally uses OpenAI for product lookup. The operations row shows EventBridge, a Lambda worker, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and SNS.

g.text: Serverless iPhone application / Deployment snapshot · November 20, 2026
AFA = adaptive feature acquisition. Routine decisions use KB rules and AFA in Lambda.
